title: Watch: Care for a Young Food Forest
scope: Guided illustrated observation of establishment care. No simulated plant growth, fixed planting sequence or measured spacing.

scenes.label: Start small
scenes.narration: This picture shows a young food forest. Start with an area you can care for.

scenes.label: Protect the soil
scenes.narration: Protect exposed soil early. Here, loose mulch covers the soil.

scenes.label: Keep the trunk clear
scenes.narration: Keep mulch away from the trunk. Notice the clear space at the tree's base.

scenes.label: Watch competition
scenes.narration: Watch for competition. The farmer is removing grass near the young tree.

scenes.label: Check, then add
scenes.narration: Before adding more plants, check moisture, shelter and the care you can provide. Let what you observe guide your next step.
